items.title: PolyShell: Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type (Arbitrary Code Execution)
items.summary: This vulnerability, also known as PolyShell, allows for unrestricted file upload with dangerous types, leading to arbitrary code execution. It has a CVSS score of 9.3 and has been actively exploited, with hundreds of stores breached by injecting malicious loaders via Magento CMS blocks.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization (Customer Account Takeover)
items.summary: Addressed in APSB26-92, this critical vulnerability with a CVSS score of 9.1 allows unauthenticated attackers to take over customer accounts. Exploitation requires no existing account, administrator privileges, or user interaction, granting access to victim's account and private data.

items.title: StyleSmuggler: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine (Remote Code Execution)
items.summary: This zero-day RCE vulnerability, dubbed StyleSmuggler, allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code with a CVSS score of 10.0. Attacks were observed starting September 4th, 2026, leading to the injection of malicious code into Magento's template system and the installation of remote access trojans.

items.title: BlockStrap: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine (Remote Code Execution)
items.summary: Fixed in APSB26-153, BlockStrap is a critical vulnerability with a CVSS score of 10.0 that enables unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution through a template engine injection. While no exploitation has been observed yet, researchers have reproduced multiple attack routes.
